title: Make failOn: newWarning work with workspace compilation
summary: The failOn: newWarning setting now detects newly introduced AL compiler warnings when workspace compilation is enabled, by running the check during the compile phase instead of the pipeline phase and handling workspace-format compiler output.
key_points: failOn: newWarning check now runs in CompileApps action for workspace compilation mode instead of RunPipeline
Parser handles both GitHub Actions annotation format and raw AL compiler output formats
Build version differences in warning messages are normalized before comparison to prevent false positives
Compiler output is preserved for baseline artifacts by passing empty buildOutputFile to RunPipeline
Added Pester tests covering both warning formats, new vs removed warnings, and version normalization
